title: Added Streaming Card Expansion Toggle
description: Implemented individual expand and collapse controls for video cards across Grid and List layouts with LocalStorage state persistence. Additionally, decoupled the app's theme logic from OS native preferences to ensure consistent dark and light mode rendering across input elements and components.

title: Added Verified Channels Streaming Capabilities
description: Added a new page where users can now watch live streams from verified channels. Usually, IPTV providers offer many types of links: normally some links only show a 404 message, some links may no longer be valid, some links are area-restricted, and some links require official tokens. To deal with this problem, after a long wait, we are finally launching a new page where almost all channels are much more likely to play instantly. We tried to solve the forever-loading issues in a more effective way, though this will normally reduce the total number of channels we can stream.
